scope: PowerShell prose candidates; includes identifiers requiring review

candidates.literal: Windows has a VB-CABLE driver record but no usable cable endpoints. First check that CABLE Input and CABLE Output are enabled in Windows Sound settings. To reinstall: click Remove Driver in the official setup that opens next, restart Windows, then run Audio driver setup again and click Install Driver. Restart once more before using SoundCurrent. Removing this shared cable affects other apps that use it.

baselinePolicy: Existing candidates are known gaps or identifiers awaiting review, not accepted translations. New candidates fail the setup test. Removing a candidate is allowed; this file is never regenerated by normal validation.
